title: HerComfort Pilot Feasibility Study — Data Dictionary
description: Machine-readable field specifications for the pilot dataset. Priority: MUST=required for primary analysis, SHOULD=secondary/exploratory, LATER=deferred.

A_participant_baseline.description: One record per participant, captured at onboarding.

participantId.description: De-identified participant key. Real userId stored separately in participant_map.json (never shared).

age.description: Participant age in years. Inclusion criterion: 18–45.

cycleLengthTypical.description: Self-reported typical menstrual cycle length. Used as covariate in mixed model.

baselinePainSeverityTypical.description: Baseline cramp severity on unmedicated cycle (VAS 0–10). Screening measure.

dysmenorrheaType.description: Medical classification. PRIMARY required for inclusion; SECONDARY included with notes.

trialArmSequence.description: Assigned 3-arm Latin-square sequence. Generated by trial_allocator.js at enrollment. Auditable and deterministic.

contraceptiveUse.description: Exogenous hormone status. Potential moderator of thermal response.

baselineMedicationHistory.description: Habitual analgesic use. Context for tookMedication field.

B_pre_session.description: Collected immediately before each session. Dual baseline 5 min apart captures spontaneous pain volatility.

painPre_tMinus5.description: Pain score 5 minutes before session start tap (VAS 0–10). App prompts at T-5 min.

painPre_t0.description: Immediate pre-session pain score at the START SESSION tap (VAS 0–10).

painPre_baseline.description: Arithmetic mean of tMinus5 and t0. Used as the primary baseline for all delta calculations.

cycleDay.description: Day of current menstrual cycle (Day 1 = first bleeding day). Required covariate in mixed model.

tookMedication.description: Whether participant took any analgesic in this menstrual cycle. ITT covariate.

trialArm.description: Arm assigned for this specific session by trial_allocator.js.

sessionOrderForParticipant.description: This participant's Nth session in the study (1, 2, or 3). Carry-over covariate in mixed model.

painPre_stabilityDelta.description: Pain trajectory direction before device activation. Positive = rising, Negative = resolving.

minutesSinceMedication.description: Time since last analgesic dose. Controls for pharmacodynamic window.

C_session_windows.description: Motor-off baseline windows. Heater AND motor are OFF during PRE_BASELINE. Every telemetry packet records windowType and heaterState.

PRE_BASELINE.purpose: Clean resting EMG baseline before any thermal or vibration stimulus.

POST_BASELINE.purpose: Clean post-treatment EMG — motor forced OFF, heater maintains temp.

windowType.description: Logged on every telemetry packet. Derived from elapsedSec thresholds at packet receipt.

D_per_packet_telemetry.description: Every telemetry packet logged individually (approx 1–2 Hz). NOT summarized into 8-second batches.

emgEnvelope.description: EMG RMS envelope signal at ~2 Hz from BioAmp circuit. Field renamed from emgRaw. This is a processed envelope, NOT raw ADC.

heaterState.description: Whether heater is physically ON. Must be false during PRE_BASELINE (first 60s). Logged every packet.

motorState.description: Whether motor is physically ON. Must be false during PRE_BASELINE and POST_BASELINE windows.

isUserModification.description: True if this packet reflects a participant-initiated change to settings.

modificationDirection.description: What the participant changed. Pilot rule: only downward changes are permitted.

modificationTimestampSec.description: elapsedSec at which the participant made a change. For ITT deviation tracking.

E_telemetry_aggregates.description: Derived from per-packet telemetry at export time. Not stored in TherapyLog — computed by export_pilot_dataset.js.

emg_pre_mean.description: Mean emgEnvelope during PRE_BASELINE window (motor+heater OFF).

emg_post_mean.description: Mean emgEnvelope during POST_BASELINE window (motor OFF).

delta_emg_clean_rms.description: EMG change score. Exploratory outcome only. Positive = muscle relaxation. Both windows are motor-OFF for clean comparison.

telemetry_packet_count.description: Total telemetry packets received for this session.

telemetry_packet_loss_pct.description: Packet loss = (expected - received) / expected × 100. Feasibility metric.

F_post_session_outcomes.description: Pain outcomes. Primary outcome is deltaPain_15min.

painPost_0min.description: Immediate post-session pain score. User must explicitly confirm via slider tap.

painPostConfirmed_0min.description: True only if user tapped the slider (not auto-filled). Session excluded from 0min analysis if false.

painPost_15min.description: Pain score 15 minutes after session. App sends push notification. PRIMARY OUTCOME.

painPostConfirmed_15min.description: True only if user responded to the 15-min push notification. Session excluded from PRIMARY analysis if false.

deltaPain_0min.description: Immediate pain change. Positive = relief. Secondary outcome.

deltaPain_15min.description: Pain change at 15 minutes. PRIMARY OUTCOME. Used in main mixed-effects analysis.

painPost_30min.description: 30-minute follow-up pain score. Exploratory. Requires push notification infrastructure.

G_pgic_and_safety.description: Patient global impression and adverse event reporting. adverseEvent is mandatory on every session.

adverseEvent.description: Was any adverse event experienced during or after the session? Mandatory safety field.

adverseCategory.description: Category of adverse event. NONE if adverseEvent=false.

adverseSeverity.description: Clinical severity. NONE if no adverse event.

earlyTermination.description: Did participant stop session before 20 min?

earlyTerminationReason.description: Reason for early stop. NONE if session completed fully.

pgicScore.description: Patient Global Impression of Change. 1=Much worse, 4=No change, 7=Much better. Exploratory.

H_device_provenance.description: Hardware and software version metadata for reproducibility and debugging.

appVersion.description: React Native / Expo app version string.

analysisModel.primary: Linear mixed-effects: deltaPain_15min ~ trialArm + cycleDay + sessionOrderForParticipant + tookMedication + (1 | participantId)
analysisModel.secondary: Paired t-test per arm pair on deltaPain_15min (Bonferroni-corrected for 3 pairs)
analysisModel.exploratory_lopo: Leave-One-Participant-Out cross-validation (ml/evaluate_lopo.py) — predictive performance only, not efficacy
analysisModel.ittPolicy: Sessions analyzed by assigned arm regardless of participant modifications (only decreasing heat/intensity permitted; all changes logged with timestamp)

limitations: No blinding: participants can feel motor vibration difference between arms. Expectation effects cannot be controlled.
No rest/sham control: thermal arm is an active comparator, not a placebo. Spontaneous regression cannot be separated from treatment effect.
Cycle-day confounding: sessions assigned across cycle days introduce phase variability. CycleDay covariate is included but insufficient to fully deconfound.
Order effects: crossover design susceptible to carry-over. Wash-out assumes next menstrual cycle, but hormonal state may vary.
Small N (feasibility target n=15): study is not powered for efficacy. Results inform future sample size calculation only.
